description: How bad is flu season in US hospitals? Returns weekly new hospital admissions for laboratory-confirmed influenza (adult and paediatric), patients currently in hospital and ICU, and the season-to-date total, nationally or for one state, from CDC's NHSN Weekly Hospital Respiratory Data. For planners, parents and reporters tracking the season. Hospital data only: it does not count flu cases in the community or deaths. (cost: 1 credit)

jurisdiction.description: string, optional, USA or 2-letter state/territory code, default USA

weeks.description: integer, optional, 1-52 most recent weeks, default 4

name: flu_hospital_admissions_weekly
